independent.derivation: Independently derived values; no upstream token values or prose copied.

rationale: Two independently selected middle greys each pass 3:1 against the declared light and dark surfaces. A 2px outline and 2px offset expose the indicator outside the control.
use: Use where a custom ring is needed and all adjacent surfaces have been measured.
avoid: This is not a full accessibility certification. Recheck images, gradients, branded fills, clipping and every new surface; retain the browser indicator if it is better.

--ds-focus-ring.derivation: Independent middle grey; measured against all declared surfaces.

--ds-focus-ring-alternate.derivation: Independent alternate middle grey; also measured against both modes.

--ds-focus-width.derivation: Original kit target: 2px ring and offset, 44px minimum control target.

--ds-focus-offset.derivation: Original kit target: 2px ring and offset, 44px minimum control target.

--ds-focus-target-min.derivation: Original kit target: 2px ring and offset, 44px minimum control target.

--ds-focus-surface-light.derivation: Invented reference surface, not an assertion about every adopted theme.

--ds-focus-surface-light-muted.derivation: Invented reference surface, not an assertion about every adopted theme.

--ds-focus-surface-dark.derivation: Invented reference surface, not an assertion about every adopted theme.

--ds-focus-surface-dark-muted.derivation: Invented reference surface, not an assertion about every adopted theme.

guidance: Use :focus-visible; never remove the default outline without a visible replacement. Leave room for the ring and check overflow clipping.
Use native controls and natural Tab order. Preserve a system-colour outline in forced-colors mode. Minimum target is a kit choice, not a claim that every WCAG target must be 44px.
No focus animation is required. Respect reduced-motion preferences elsewhere; use platform focus APIs on native.
example:
.example-control:focus-visible { outline: var(--focus-width,2px) solid var(--focus-color,#777777); outline-offset: var(--focus-offset,2px); }
@media (forced-colors: active) { .example-control:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid Highlight; } }
